aggregate: Four short bars of different heights feeding along arrows into one tall bar as high as all of them put together
asset: A balance whose right pan is pulled right down by a fat sack of coins while the empty left pan rides high, with a green arrow rising beside the loaded side
awe: A person standing at the bottom of an enormous cliff wall that runs off the top of the picture, looking all the way up it
bacteria: Rod shaped and round single cells seen hugely magnified, one of them pinched in the middle as it splits in two
barley: An ear of barley on its stalk, with long bristles rising from the grains
blast radius: One broken node at the centre of three rings, the parts nearest it fully coloured and the ones furthest out barely touched
blocked: A road running into the distance with a felled tree lying right across it and one car halted a short way short of the trunk
brittle: A rigid rod snapping sharply under downward pressure
build out: A small two-part frame on the left and the same frame on the right grown to nine parts
capsule: A thin sleeve being drawn down over the cork and the top of a bottle neck, so that the seal ends up covered
cede ground: A frontier line pushed backwards so that a band of land which used to belong to one side is now shaded as the other side's
chorus of: A packed row of heads and shoulders with a dozen speech bubbles going up from them all at once
concentrated: Two jars: a full jar of pale liquid steaming, and beside it half as much liquid in a far deeper colour
congested: A road seen from above with both lanes filled nose to tail by cars and buses that cannot move, though nothing at all stands in their way
congestion: A crossroads seen from above with every lane packed bumper to bumper and vehicles stuck inside the junction itself
contender: Two figures of identical build set either side of a line, each braced and leaning in towards the other
cork: A cork stopper lifted just above the neck of a bottle
counterculture: A wide river flowing one way, with one narrow stream inside it deliberately pushing back the other way
counterproductive: Someone shoving a crate hard to the right while the result loops overhead and ends up pointing back the other way
dark horse: A field of pale racehorses bunched together while one dark horse comes past them and takes the lead
dissolve: A sugar cube standing in a glass of water, half of it already eaten away, its dashed original outline still marked and grains of it drifting off into the water
echo: A speech bubble with two steadily fainter copies of itself trailing away to the side
efficiency: A wide arrow feeding into a machine and an almost equally wide arrow coming out, with only a thin wisp escaping as waste
equivalent: A balance at rest with a square block on one pan and a round ball on the other, the beam sitting perfectly level
era: A timeline running off in both directions with one stretch of it walled off between two red bars and shaded as a single period
fend off: A raised shield with two arrows striking it and glancing away to the sides instead of getting through
fine: A penalty notice demanding a sum of money, left tucked under the windscreen wiper of a car
front-runner: Three runners on a track with one of them far out in front and the gap back to the other two marked across the top
frontier: A surveyed map with contour rings and grid lines that stops at a ragged dashed border, beyond which the sheet is blank, and an arrow heading out into the blank part
germinate: A seed under the soil sending a root down and a green shoot up into the air
go off on a tangent: A closed circular track with one line that touches it at a single point and then flies off dead straight
go off the rails: A train that has left the track, its front end down among the broken sleepers and the rail torn out of line behind it
grain: A heap of small hard cereal kernels, each with a centre crease
grist: Whole kernels tipping from a hopper into the centre of a turning millstone and coarse ground meal spraying out at the rim into heaps
hand in your notice: One hand holding a sealed letter out across a desk and a second hand reaching in from the other side to take it
handful of: An open hand, fingers up and thumb out, with five small round objects sitting in the palm
heat conductor: A flame under one end of a metal bar, with heat travelling the length of the bar to the hand gripping the far end
hinder: A walker whose footsteps get shorter and shorter as one barrier after another is put across the way ahead
hypocrite: A scowling figure holding up a cheerful grinning mask beside its own face
in order of priority: Five numbered bars stacked top to bottom, the first the longest and each one after it shorter
incursion: Armed arrows pushing across a marked frontier into the shaded country on the other side
leapfrog: One figure springing off the back of a crouching one and coming down in front of it, the jump traced as a dashed arc
liability: The same balance, this time dragged right down on the left by a heavy cracked iron weight, with a red arrow falling beside the loaded side
mainstream: A wide river channel carrying almost all the flow, next to the one thin side channel that takes the little which leaves it
malt: Grains that have each sprouted a shoot, spread out on a perforated floor with warm air rising up through the holes to dry them
mash: Ground malt stirred into hot water in a tun, with steam rising and a paddle turning
multi-tenancy: One building under a single roof divided by thick walls into four sealed units, each occupied by a different colour
myriad: A field of hundreds of small dots packed edge to edge, far too many to count, thinning away towards the corners
order of magnitude: Three bars on one baseline, the second ten times the height of the first and the third ten times the second
paradox: An impossible triangle whose three beams each meet the next quite normally, yet together close a loop that could not exist
prominent: A row of identical low pillars with a single one among them standing far taller and in a much stronger colour
prong: A table fork lying at an angle with three long separate points, the middle one filled in red and an arrow picking it out
rake: A long-handled rake with a row of teeth being pulled through loose grain, leaving it combed into neat lines
read between the lines: A written page whose plain lines are dark and even, with a fainter extra line of writing showing in the gap between two of them
rebound: A ball dropping to the floor and springing back up again, its path traced as a dashed line that ends in an arrow
recreational activity: Two people throwing a ball to each other on the grass beside a park bench, with a clock reading five o'clock
runaway degradation: A downward spiral whose turns get tighter and darker on every pass, ending in a red point at the bottom with no way back up
runway: An aeroplane climbing away off the far end of a long marked strip that runs back towards the viewer
safeguard: A rock falling out of the sky strikes a shield that has been put in its way, and the person standing underneath is untouched
shadowing: One incoming request splitting in two: a solid line into a live system whose answer goes on out, and a dashed copy into a second greyed-out system whose answer is thrown away
soak: Grain left fully under the water line in a tank, swelling as it takes the liquid in
sprout: A seed whose coat has just split, pushing one white root down into the soil and one small green shoot up through the surface
squeeze as much juice out of: A hand pressing down on a cut lemon half hard enough to force one last drop out of it
stalled processing: Items backed up on a conveyor behind a closed gate, nothing broken and nothing moving, with a clock running beside them
starch: A potato cut through, the pale flat face turned towards us, with a magnified circle showing the grains packed inside it
steep: Grain sitting well under the water line in a jar, beside a clock whose hands have swept round to show hours passing
step down: A figure walking away from a raised platform it has left empty, down onto the ground
stretched to the limit: A rubber band looped over two pegs and hauled so far apart that it has gone thin and is straining along its length
subculture: The wide river held back in pale outline while the one small channel that leaves it and then runs its own course beside it is picked out in solid green
surveillance: A camera bolted to a wall, its cone of view thrown across two people walking below it
suture: A cut in the skin pulled shut and held closed by four evenly spaced stitches of thread
testify: A witness standing in the box with one hand raised, speaking across to a judge's bench with a gavel lying on it
three-pronged: Three separate arrows coming in from three different directions and all striking the same bullseye
transcription: The spelling of a word written above the symbols for the sounds it is actually made of, with an arrow from one to the other
trial: A court in session: the judge sitting high behind the bench with a gavel beside them, a boxed row of jurors, and the two opposing sides at their tables below
underdog: A race almost over: two runners are reaching the finish line while the one picked out in colour is still trailing far behind
unmet demand: Two bars side by side: a tall one for what people want and a short one for what is actually supplied, with the shortfall above the short bar hatched in red
vandal: A hooded figure holding a spray can in front of a wall they have scrawled red marks across
vandalize: The glass panel of a bus shelter smashed through, cracks running out from the hole to the frame, with the brick that did it lying below
wager: Two stacks of chips shoved into the middle of a card table while a coin spins in the air above, its outcome not yet known
walking paradox: One walking figure split down the middle: the left half solid with a raised arm and a smile, the right half only a dashed outline with a dropped arm and a frown
washback: A tall wooden vessel of fermenting liquid, froth rising to the brim
witness: A person standing in a courtroom witness box with one hand raised to swear that what they saw is true
wort: Sweet liquid running out of the tap of a mash tun into a jug below, with the spent grain left sitting in the tun
yeast: Round yeast cells budding off smaller cells, with gas bubbles rising past them
